page.layout: One blank leather or vellum-covered cover board, with four binding tabs on the left edge and two green ribbon ties on the right edge. No printed text on this page. A Herzog August Bibliothek Wolfenbüttel grey scale ruler and the HAB/DFG digitiser banner are present on the scan and are excluded.
page.notes: The scan shows the outside of the book's front cover, not a printed page. There is no printed text, so nothing is transcribed. Visible items excluded as not printed: the library's grey scale strip, the "HAB http://diglib.hab.de/..." banner and the DFG logo. A few small dark spots on the cover are stains, not text.
